hooks.name: Corporate Agent OS: validate task contracts on save
hooks.description: When a task contract JSON under 10-decisions/tasks is saved, validate it against the task schema.

hooks.name: Corporate Agent OS: validate memory ledger on save
hooks.description: When the project memory ledger is saved, validate ids, types and fact provenance.

hooks.name: Corporate Agent OS: remind about gates before stopping
hooks.description: Before the agent finishes a turn in an orchestrated project, remind it to report gate status and NOT_RUN items.

action.prompt: Before finishing: list every quality gate touched in this session with its verdict file path, every human approval obtained or still required, and every test, scan or review that was NOT_RUN. Do not describe anything as production-ready while a gate is NOT_ASSESSED.
